guardbee-demo · live cluster simulation
01 / INSPECT

Sample Real Traffic

Ground truth directly from Hubble Relay flows — never synthetic test cases.

02 / SIMULATE

Diff Against Baseline

Evaluates candidate policy twice using Cilium's embedded pkg/policy engine.

03 / CATCH

Flag Silent Regressions

Instantly detects NEWLY_DROPPED flows (like kubelet health probes) before merge.

04 / REMEDIATE

One-Click Fix & Re-verify

Appends missing rules in one click, re-runs simulator, and confirms 100% unchanged.

Same engine, if you live in a terminal

$ guardbee verdict \
  -n homeassistant allow-mosquitto.yaml NEWLY_DROPPED prometheus → :8123 NEWLY_DROPPED reserved:host → :8123 (×4) 131 flows sampled — 5 would BREAK if merged as-is
$ guardbee verdict \
  -n homeassistant merge-ready.yaml 0 newly dropped 0 newly allowed 159 flows sampled — safe to merge

This isn't a linter.

Real engine

Embeds Cilium's actual pkg/policy code — the same engine your cluster runs. Not a reimplementation that can drift.

Real traffic

Diffs against live Hubble flows from your cluster, not synthetic test cases someone imagined.

Local-first

Runs with your own kubeconfig. No new cluster footprint, no agent to deploy, nothing leaves your laptop.
